evidence: Voted Aye on the House motion to concur on the One Big Beautiful Bill Act with its Medicaid cuts and work requirements (Jul 2025, 218-214).
Voted against the Women's Health Protection Act, H.R. 3755, in the House (Sep 2021, 218-211).
Voted Aye on final House passage of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act and its tax cuts (Jul 2025, 218-214).
Cosponsor of H.J.Res. 12 (119th, Jan 2025), Ralph Norman's amendment capping House members at three terms and senators at two.
Urged Senate GOP to enforce a talking filibuster to pass the SAVE America Act, calling the modern filibuster an obstacle; a narrower change, not abolition (Mar 2026).
Voted against H.R. 1834, the discharge-petition bill extending the enhanced ACA premium credits for three years (Jan 2026, 230-196).
Listed as a cosponsor of H.R. 3514, the Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act of 2025 (119th Congress).
Voted for H.R. 7024, the Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act, which expanded refundability of the Child Tax Credit (Jan 2024, 357-70).
Voted Yea on final House passage of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (H.R. 6644), sending it to the President (Jun 2026, 358-32).
Voted for the narrower House Stop Insider Trading Act, H.R. 7008 (Jul 2026, 232-198), not the Peters-Hawley full ban; said in Apr 2026 she'd support an insider-trading bill.
Voted against H.R. 51, the Washington, D.C. Admission Act, in the House (Apr 2021, 216-208).
Voted Nay on H.Con.Res. 93, the War Powers resolution directing removal of U.S. forces from hostilities with Iran (Sep 2026, 220-204).
Voted Nay on H.J.Res. 72, which would end the national emergency behind Trump's Canada tariffs (Feb 2026, 219-211).
Voted for H.R. 8369, which barred withholding weapons deliveries to Israel (May 2024, 224-187); a related but different bill, so capped at Lean.
Campaign issues page says he would support and cosponsor the Medicare for All Act; called it his top priority (2026).
Campaign issues page commits to making abortion rights federal law; he also cosponsored Maine's LD 1619 abortion protections (2026).
Campaign issues page backs a comprehensive ban on members trading individual stocks, with divestment or blind-trust requirements (2026).
Issues page: rejects corporate PAC money, backs an amendment to overturn Citizens United and public financing; no explicit PAC ban (2026).
Campaign issues page calls for dismantling and abolishing ICE, citing a fatal ICE shooting in Biddeford (2026), going beyond reforms.
Campaign issues page calls Gaza a genocide and pledges to end U.S. funding for Israel's military (2026).
Issues page says he'd push federal drug price negotiation like Canada's; wrote Maine's drug affordability board law; no SMART Prices pledge (2026).
Campaign issues page pledges to cut taxes for working families and expand the Child Tax Credit and EITC (2026).
Pledges to make billionaires pay more (lift payroll-tax cap) and calls the GOP cuts giveaways to the wealthiest (Sep 2026); no explicit repeal pledge.
Campaign issues page explicitly supports the PRO Act to make it easier to unionize and bargain (2026).
Said the OBBBA Medicaid cuts are hurting Maine 'big time' and faulted Collins for advancing the bill (Sep 2026); no explicit repeal pledge.
Called Trump's on-off tariff approach 'idiotic' and harmful to Maine forestry, fishing and farming (Sep 2026); criticized Canada tariffs in Oct debate.
In the Oct 2026 debate faulted Collins for letting the Iran war happen when she could have stopped it five times, implying war-powers support.
In the Oct 2026 debate lightning round agreed there should be more AI guardrails; no stance on state preemption found.
